instantiated_cells.justification: §91000 makes knowing/willful violations a misdemeanor with fines up to $10,000 or three times the amount unreported; §91005.5 imposes civil penalties up to $5,000 per violation; and §91013 imposes $10/day late-filing liability — all applicable to lobbying disclosure violations under Title 9.
